figures.alt: Dusk view over a dense city with air taxis and drones above the skyline, linked by glowing flight paths.
Rendering of two white passenger eVTOL aircraft with four ducted rotors flying above a landing pad at sunset.
Rendering of multirotor drones carrying cardboard parcels above a city.
Oblique view of a textured 3D city model with streets and buildings of different heights.
CFD wind field around building blocks, colored by velocity magnitude from 0 to 1 on a black background.
Left, a gray 3D OpenStreetMap model of Atlanta with thousands of buildings; right, a CFD wind field around a cluster of buildings.
